movies.title: The Legend of Maula Jatt
movies.synopsis: An epic tale of rivalry, honor, and raw vengeance. Maula Jatt, a fierce prizefighter with a tortured past, seeks vengeance against his mortal enemy Noori Natt, the fiercest warrior in the land of Punjab.

movies.title: Kamli
movies.synopsis: A poetic psychological drama exploring unspoken love, longing, and mystery in rural Punjab. Hina waits yearningly for her missing husband until a mysterious wanderer ignites dormant passions.

movies.title: Na Maloom Afraad 2
movies.synopsis: Farhan, Moon, and Shakeel reunite for another chaotic, high-stakes comedy adventure when an elusive Sheikh's gold toilet goes missing during an extravagant destination wedding in Dubai.

movies.title: Jawani Phir Nahi Ani 2
movies.synopsis: The ultimate festive Pakistani comedy romance adventure. Sherry and his friends travel to Turkey for another hilarious rollercoaster ride of love, misunderstandings, and high society chaos.

movies.title: Parwaaz Hai Junoon
movies.synopsis: A heartfelt tribute to the Pakistan Air Force, depicting the lives, cadets training, high-octane aerial dogfights, patriotism, and emotional sacrifices of courageous fighter pilots.

movies.title: London Nahi Jaunga
movies.synopsis: A grand romantic comedy drama that spans from rustic Punjab villages to the bustling cityscapes of London. Jameel travels all the way to London to win back the woman he loves against family traditions.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.synopsis: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between love and the fate of the universe, he prevents a terrible future only he can foresee.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.synopsis: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb, followed by the political persecution and moral turbulence of the atomic age.
